campaign.title: The Goblin Caves of Thornwick
campaign.subtitle: A Classic D&D 5e Adventure for Levels 1-3
campaign.description: A traditional dungeon crawl through goblin-infested caves, perfect for new players and Dungeon Masters. Features exploration, combat, roleplay, and treasure hunting.
campaign.author: DMLog Templates

setup.premise: The peaceful village of Thornwick has been plagued by goblin raids. Merchant caravans have been attacked, and the village elder's daughter, Mira, has been kidnapped. The party must venture into the Thornwick Caves to rescue her and put an end to the goblin threat.
hooks: The party arrives in Thornwick just as a merchant caravan limps into town, wounded and robbed
A desperate village elder offers gold and magical rewards for rescuing his daughter
Local rumors speak of ancient dwarven ruins within the caves, promising treasure
A surviving merchant mentions seeing organized goblins with unusual weapons

backgroundInformation.village: Thornwick is a small farming community of about 200 people, known for its apple orchards and position along the main trade route.
backgroundInformation.goblins: The Redfang Tribe has recently been driven from their ancestral home by expanding human settlements. They've taken refuge in old dwarven caves.
backgroundInformation.caves: Originally mined by dwarves 200 years ago, the caves were abandoned after a cave-in. Recent goblin activity has opened new passages.
backgroundInformation.kidnapVictim: Mira Thornwick, 16, is the village elder's daughter and apprentice healer. She was taken during a herb-gathering expedition.

acts.title: Arrival in Thornwick
acts.description: The party arrives in the village and learns of the goblin problem

scenes.title: The Wounded Caravan
scenes.description: A merchant caravan arrives wounded and robbed as the party enters Thornwick

skillChallenges.success: Heal wounded merchants, gain their trust and additional information
skillChallenges.failure: Merchants remain suspicious, limited information shared

skillChallenges.success: Realize the attacks are more organized than typical goblin raids
skillChallenges.failure: Miss important tactical information about goblin strategy

scenes.title: The Elder's Plea
scenes.description: Village Elder Aldric explains the situation and offers rewards for rescuing his daughter
rewards: Promise of 200 gp upon Mira's return
information: Mira was taken 3 days ago while gathering moonflower herbs
Goblins left clear tracks toward the old mining caves
Previous rescue attempts by village guards failed
Strange goblin war cries heard from the caves at night

acts.title: The Journey to the Caves
acts.description: Travel through the Thornwick Forest to reach the cave entrance

scenes.title: Forest Ambush
scenes.description: Goblin scouts attempt to ambush the party on the forest path

enemies.name: Goblin Scout
enemies.tactics: Use hit-and-run tactics from behind trees, focus fire on spellcasters

enemies.name: Goblin Boss
enemies.tactics: Stays back initially, charges when scouts are defeated

scenes.terrain: Dense forest with large trees providing cover, stream running through center
treasures: Mira's torn cloak piece (proof she's alive)

skillChallenges.success: Learn password to enter caves safely

scenes.title: The Cave Entrance
scenes.description: The party reaches the caves and must decide how to enter
features: Fresh goblin tracks leading in and out

skillChallenges.failure: Guards raise alarm, +2 goblins in first cave room

skillChallenges.success: Discover hidden cache with minor healing potions

acts.title: Into the Goblin Caves
acts.description: Explore the cave complex, face increasing challenges, and rescue Mira

scenes.title: The Guard Post
scenes.description: The first chamber of the caves, used as a guard post by the goblins

enemies.name: Goblin
enemies.tactics: Two guard the main passage, two sleep by fire (can be surprised)

scenes.terrain: Natural cave chamber with fire pit, sleeping furs, crude barricade

scenes.title: The Mushroom Garden
scenes.description: A chamber where goblins cultivate phosphorescent mushrooms for light and food

skillChallenges.success: Goblin surrenders and provides information about Mira's location
skillChallenges.failure: Goblin attempts to flee and alert others

skillChallenges.success: Identify edible mushrooms, gain rations and discover medicinal variety

treasures: Phosphorescent mushrooms (can be used as light sources)
Small silver coins scattered in stream (15 sp)

scenes.title: The Prison Chamber
scenes.description: Where Mira is being held, along with other prisoners from caravan attacks
keyNPCs: Halfling Bard Pip (wounded, captured weeks ago)

enemies.name: Goblin
enemies.tactics: Guard the prisoners, one attempts to use Mira as hostage

complications: Prisoners are weak and need healing
Goblin may threaten to kill hostages
Cell doors are locked (thieves' tools DC 12 or Strength DC 15)
information: Chief Snagtooth plans to ransom prisoners to nearby towns
More goblins live deeper in the caves
Ancient dwarven treasure room exists somewhere in the complex

scenes.title: The Chief's Throne Room
scenes.description: Final confrontation with the goblin chief in the deepest chamber of the caves

enemies.name: Goblin Boss (Chief Snagtooth)
enemies.tactics: Commands other goblins, uses lair actions to collapse ceiling (minor damage)

enemies.name: Goblin
enemies.tactics: Protect their chief, use pack tactics when possible

scenes.terrain: Large natural cavern with raised stone platform (throne), multiple levels connected by crude ramps
lair_actions: Cause small rocks to fall (DC 13 Dex save or take 1d4 damage)
Enhance goblin attacks (+2 damage for one round)
treasures: Chief's treasure chest: 200 gp, gem of seeing, potion of healing (superior)
Maps showing other goblin tribes in the region

npcs.name: Aldric Thornwick
npcs.description: A weathered human in his 60s with kind eyes but worry lines. He's the village leader and Mira's father.
secrets: Knows of ancient dwarven treasure in the caves

npcs.name: Mira Thornwick
npcs.description: A bright 16-year-old human with brown hair and green eyes. She's brave but untrained in combat.
abilities: Can cast cure wounds once per day (innate ability)

npcs.name: Chief Snagtooth
npcs.description: A large goblin with filed teeth and numerous scars. Cunning and ruthless leader of the Redfang Tribe.
tactics: Fights to the death to maintain honor

monsters.name: Goblin
actions: Shortbow: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft, 1d6+2 piercing damage

monsters.name: Goblin Boss
actions: Redirect Attack: Force attacker to target different creature

items.name: Scimitar +1
items.description: A finely crafted curved blade with dwarven runes etched along the fuller.

items.name: Gem of Seeing
items.description: A crystal that reveals hidden truths when gazed through.

handouts.title: Partial Cave Map
handouts.description: A crude goblin-drawn map showing some cave passages
handouts.playerVersion: Shows entrance and first two chambers only
handouts.dmVersion: Shows complete layout with secret passages marked

handouts.title: Mira's Hidden Message
handouts.description: A small note Mira managed to hide for potential rescuers
handouts.content: Father - I am alive but weak. Chief speaks of selling us to slavers from the east. Three guards, chief has wolf. Be careful of cave-ins in deep chambers. Your loving daughter, M.

treasure: Magic items: Scimitar +1, Gem of Seeing

forLevel1.partySize: Designed for 4 players, adjust encounter numbers for different party sizes

dmTips: Emphasize the rescue mission urgency without making it feel rushed
Use Mira's knowledge of herbs to provide healing outside of spells
Allow creative problem-solving - goblins can be negotiated with
The caves can be expanded if the party enjoys dungeon exploration
Consider having rescued NPCs provide future adventure hooks
